description.value: Rose Valley Regional Park is a nature reserve managed by the Regional District of Central Okanagan, located near Kelowna. The park is part of the RDCO's network of over 2,100 hectares of regional parkland with 86+ km of designated trails. It is day-use only, offering a natural setting for hiking and exploring the Central Okanagan landscape.

No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other specific amenities at Rose Valley was found in the website content or OSM tags.
